features.name: State, boot and modes
features.acceptance: Separate durable state from actor/render state. New game, load, ending continuation, cooking and asynchronous loading are distinct transitions. Initial source brain/time differ from slice.

features.name: Movement and physicality
features.source: `core/update.js:updateWorld`; `systems/physicality.js` motion, door-gap, clear-placement and detour functions
features.acceptance: Preserve speed effects, stun/slow, collision on all real architecture, accessible counters/doors and reachable objectives. Convert world relations to metres; validate actual walking paths, not just straight lines.

features.name: Main loop and withdrawal
features.acceptance: Source normal high consumes one real rock, -50 shakes, -4 brain, +1 cred, lifetime and faction/quest hooks; +30 shakes at expiry. Soap, hitter, recognition and royal-static branches are missing. Source withdrawal is frame/RNG/iframe dependent; slice uses 0.72HP/s approximation.

features.name: Input and interaction arbitration
features.acceptance: Preserve precedence for doors, campaign/route targets, NPCs, activity sites, props, zone verbs, then pockets. In 3D the reticle/reach/LOS should nominate an eligible target through the same resolver that produces the prompt. Menus clear held input; every conversation needs an exit. Desktop plus browser is the selected platform scope; touch controls are a separate parity decision, not an implied new primary platform.

features.name: Inventory, equipment, weapons, tools
features.acceptance: Preserve item identity/quantity, shoes/hat/coat/tool, derived HP/speed/cred/charisma/wanted decay, one weapon and one tool in hand. Torch/crowbar displacement goes to Pete's locker; ownership includes locker, usage checks equipped tool. Do not add weapon durability: no live durability system was found.

features.name: Core vendors and economy
features.acceptance: Source includes single/bulk sales, faction rates/refusals, charisma price quotes, license plates, tool stock/locker, loans, hideout offers, counters and quest hooks. Pete total outlay cap $200/day. Sock-for-$1 is a real source fallback. Yuri baseline25 vs Pete15; faction modifications must also port.

features.name: Supply, fencing and cooking economy
features.acceptance: Clean/dirty packet distinction, dirty-first consumption, Barb six packets/day, crossword discount, Pinky alternatives, Stripe loyalty/betrayal and daily fence ladder/cap. Prices quoted through `vendorPrice` have source-specific exceptions; do not apply one universal discount policy.

features.name: Dumpster, trash, pickups and lottery
features.acceptance: Port randomized three-options/take-one dumpster contents, distance bias, equipment/food/packets/weapon/torch/hitter/possum outcomes, cooldowns, trash rat outcomes, tips jar, truck resets, real cash-pile identity, lottery and quest pickups. Slice daily reset and copper ground pickup are explicit substitutes.

features.name: NPC agency and lifecycle
features.acceptance: Default chase, zone-only aggression, patrol, wander, day/night presence, sleep, shop closure, chatter, pets, allies, walk-off and essential actors. Rendering an NPC is not implementing its behavior. Preserve stable base IDs and transient/guard/pretender distinctions.

features.name: Basic combat
features.acceptance: Source weapons/reach/cooldowns, random14–22 base damage, high/cart/vulnerability multipliers, hit-stun, iframes, knockback, combo rewards/reset, breakable bottles, wanted-on-peaceful-hit, drops, faction and achievement effects. Lurch is source55HP, slice120HP; no daily respawn/reward substitute may silently become parity.

features.name: Combat archetypes/projectiles
features.acceptance: Charger windup→fixed-direction lunge→vulnerable recovery; grabber stun; swarmer pair/cap; ranged spacing/aim/throws; fallen-priest two phases; default chase; Brendan taser. Projectile collision and telegraphs need 3D adapters, not a rewrite of reward/status logic.

features.name: Police, death and arrest
features.acceptance: Wanted0–3, decay18s (collar multiplier), regular and Brendan spawn rules, radio backup, four-cop cap, dog slowdown and arrest. Death keeps cash/items, HP60/shakes30/cred-10/wanted0; arrest takes floor(70% cash), real rocks, HP40/shakes100. Source death does not explicitly clear high/crash; slice does.

features.name: Tony, co-op and other local bosses
features.acceptance: Tony challenge/offenses, coat phases and Sherri adds; Stripe ally and irreversible co-op choice; older Brutus trigger/phases; fallen priest; old-school encounter and guaranteed first challenge. Rewards and retry/ending state differ. Each real boss must remain defeatable in <90s by a competent player.

features.name: Intro, quests, ranks and achievements
features.acceptance: All24 quest IDs and49 achievements; earn10→Tony→smoke intro, world suppression and one-shot old-save behavior; eight rank thresholds0/10/25/50/100/200/400/800. Rank does not simply recompute downwards when cred falls. Preserve quest flags, offers and alternate completion branches.

features.name: Daily hustles and Block routes
features.acceptance: Fourteen hustle templates and snapshot progress; three-stop endless routes, early pool, unlock flags, last-stop exclusion, bounded cash/cred, route milestones and office unlock. Route rewards must be one transaction, including freshly rolled next route.

features.name: Factions and territory
features.acceptance: Three independent reputations clamped -50..50; hated≤-10, liked≥10, loved≥25. Price/stock/loan/drop/refusal/ambient/brain/heat effects, territory cash multipliers, greetings and overlapping-zone resolution. Kingdom allegiance is deliberately separate.

features.name: Office, claims and work orders
features.acceptance: Three routes unlock $40+1copper purchase; six upgrades; eleven claims with survey→file→install; faction gate where applicable; rising fee plus1copper; radio/claimed-district work, mutually exclusive active jobs, daily1–3 orders, bounded net payouts, milestone reconciliation. No passive income. Leasing Guy and Gutter Greg remain essential.

features.name: Kingdom and endless succession
features.acceptance: Owned office +four claims +Tony victory; radio summons; three correction marks then ruler per clan; seals; real Block rock; Emperor phases; folding-chair ending; guarded districts and daily paid pretender. Preserve abort-on-escape/death, save demotion to retry, no duplicate boss payouts and no guard/add/combo farming.

features.name: Clock, weather, day events and sleeping
features.acceptance: Day3 visitor, day7 silence, day14 inheritance, day30 bus; weather rain/fog, night finds/shop/presence, Price Guy every third day, rent, mom calls/pass, schedules and sleeping. Distinguish active-world clocks from real-wall-time `Date.now` and UI timers; see discrepancy ledger below.

features.name: Hideouts and shared stash
features.acceptance: Scrap shed ownership, Mom nightly rent/eviction, discrete rest/sleep, phone reset, shared rocks/copper/cash stash surviving death/arrest. `items` stash array exists but item deposit/withdraw is not wired; do not describe it as a shipped feature. Modal interiors are functional source truth; physical rooms can expose those same actions.

features.name: Cart and bus travel
features.acceptance: Exactly one rideable cart, mount/dismount, equipment-aware capped speed and cart contact combat. Bus pass acquired via Pinky/Mom; one consumed ride/day; visited/known destinations, combat/wanted restriction and arrival placement. Existing optional bus travel must not be removed by misreading old “no fast travel” prose.

features.name: Recognition, concessions, discovery
features.acceptance: Four venue ledgers; sit/bother/buy/sell/full_high; tiers3/8/15; visit dedup; no resource rewards. Conceded +night/choir clock/live freed dog/dryer midcycle enables four conditional spots. Discovery changes knowledge only. Clock seeds/phases persist separately from shared RNG. One real smoke transaction; action-time condition check; expiry records current venue.

features.name: Emergency hitter
features.source: `hitter.js`; `update.js` high boundary; dumpster and pocket hooks
features.acceptance: Two copper craft or rare far dumpster find; location-free lowest-priority pocket action;6s high/14s crash, shakes relief20/+35 crash,brain-8; no normal smoke/recognition/royal-static reward. Cannot convert back to copper or create a second permanent smoke loop.

features.name: Robbery
features.acceptance: Only `skid_lurch` landed grab; before damage;60s cooldown/two per day; one bounded cash/item/equipment/hitter loss; quest/progression/tool exemptions and no reclaim payout. Alley Lurch and other grabbers must not inherit this flag.

features.name: Copper sites and break-ins
features.acceptance: One engine, four copper locations share3/day and2–4 copper; five break-ins use separate2/day counter and fixed small non-copper/non-rock loot. Tool/cred gate before charging attempt; stage-specific choices, lockpick, item/cash costs, failure/death, alternative no-take and exits. Site residents are real dialogue identities even without actor spawns.

features.name: Cooking heat minigame
features.acceptance: Five modes, packet quantity gates, dirty-first consumption, needle/sweet spot/brain/high effects, lock/auto-burn/600ms reveal, bail consumption and six outcome classes. Real rocks, inventory soap and smokeable soap-rock counter are distinct. Render the bar in Godot; keep mathematical outcomes independently testable.

features.name: Other activities
features.acceptance: Eight-step karaoke with forfeit, four-pin reset/brain penalty, market panhandle variants, crate thoughts/sleep, park continuous sit/movement cancel, old-school rip gates, all-cash Price Guy outcomes and departure. A menu with the name but no branches is not completion.

features.name: Communications, Possum and ambient events
features.acceptance: Calls, intro mom tip/proud call, ticker, eight-post feed, public-phone ringing/window/planted cash,29 events, local prophecy pool and optional host bridge fallback, pet possum/revealed cash, garbage truck. Preserve no-network playable fallback; do not add an API-key requirement or other AI NPCs.

features.name: Living-neighborhood incidents
features.source: `incidents.js` scheduler, required-actor checks, six definitions and actor updates
features.acceptance: Mattress, possum inventory, laundromat walkout, Yuri receipt, dry park committee, ticketed luggage. One ephemeral scene, three/day, seen mask, zone/weather/required NPC conditions, combat/script interruption, retained durable history, no rewards/quest/NPC mutation leakage.

features.name: HUD, map, guidance and presentation
features.acceptance: One current BAD IDEA, urgency/nearest legal smoke target, inventory/equipment/lifetime/achievement panels, quest/faction/route/office/kingdom/recognition/vendor index, feed, full map, name/health/aggro labels, status effects, weather, graffiti/posters, district lights and audio feedback. Replace Canvas render mechanisms while preserving readable information and content.

features.name: Persistence and recovery
features.acceptance: Full schema needs all domain state listed below, stable spatial IDs and independent namespace. Persist the result of each paid transition once, await storage, no duplicate rewards, restore essential actors, clear unsafe modal/encounter state and reconcile progress witnesses.

features.name: Audio and packaging
features.acceptance: Keep input-gated initialization, mute and cached ugly short waveforms; add missing rank/boss/windup/projectile/radio/ambient cues. Retain pinned Godot4.5.1 Compatibility/single-thread Web, hashed game-data pack and capture fallback. Full actor AI/browser save/complete-campaign testing remains required.
